KFS, contracting and disbursement

A source-linked technical walkthrough. Trace the flow, explain the boundary, then test the failure path.

After this session, you can:
  • Explain disclosure readiness
  • Trace document evidence
  • Describe the fund-flow guard

Technical flow

Every hand-off is a control boundary: on failure the flow holds, refers or denies — it never skips ahead.

  1. 01Approved terms
  2. 02KFS render
  3. 03Delivery + acceptance
  4. 04Agreement + eSign
  5. 05Bank/payee verification
  6. 06Fund-flow decision
  7. 07Disburse + open LMS

1. KFS before commitment

The platform calculates APR and charges, renders the KFS and amortisation disclosure, records digital delivery and acceptance, and prevents sanction readiness when evidence is incomplete.

2. Execution packet

Sanction letter, agreement summary, privacy notice, checksums, delivery and eSign evidence form a versioned packet. A later dispute should reconstruct exactly what the borrower received and accepted.

3. Money moves last

Bank-account verification, mandate/payment evidence, purpose-specific payee rules and direct fund-flow controls run before disbursement. A failed provider or ambiguous beneficiary blocks the transition; it does not create a loan account.
